_nguon: EN-ALL GĐ 6 — mẫu câu tiếng Anh của lớp HỎI ĐÁP Kinh Dịch (hoidap/kinhdich.py, đoạn mở đầu que_mo, khối hình hào, câu hỏi tiếp / gợi ý / hỏi lại). Lời bài đọc quẻ (doc_que) ở en/loi/kinhdich.json. Ban biên tập viết từ nghĩa; thuật ngữ theo thuat_ngu_en.json.
hoi.kd.dt.ghi_ung: The question is about the other person or the matter itself, so the Response line (Ying) stands for it.
hoi.kd.dt.ghi_the: The question is about you yourself (your health, a journey, your own path), so the Self line (Shi) stands for it.
hoi.kd.dt.quan_quy: In Zeng Shan Bu Yi: office, career standing and a husband are read through the Officer line.
hoi.kd.dt.the_tai: Money, goods and a wife are read through the Wealth line.
hoi.kd.dt.phu_mau: Documents, homes and people above you are read through the Parent line.
hoi.kd.dt.tu_ton: Children, protection and medicine are read through the Offspring line.
hoi.kd.dt.huynh_de: Equals and rivals are read through the Sibling line.
hoi.kd.luu_y.nghia_ly: Here the hexagram works as a mirror for looking again at your choice, not as a verdict. The final decision rests on the real facts of your situation.
hoi.kd.luu_y.du_doan: The Six Lines (Na Jia) reading shows which way things lean from the structure of the hexagram; it is a cultural reference, not a certain outcome. Decide in advance what would show this reading was wrong.
hoi.kd.luu_y.mai_hoa: The Plum Blossom reading gives a quick sense of the matter in front of you through the body and use trigrams; use it only for short-term, concrete matters.
hoi.kd.luu_y.hao_tu: The line statements are quoted from the original Zhou Yi; the translation and commentary are an editorial draft awaiting an expert's check.
hoi.kd.luu_y.vuong_suy: Line strength is worked out in a simplified way (month by solar term, day branch, void branches); hidden movement, day clashes, a line turning back on itself and timing are not yet weighed, so any call on success or failure is still rough.
hoi.kd.mau.can_que: To answer through the I Ching we need a hexagram. Tap 'Cast' (the system throws the coins at random), enter six lines you cast yourself, or choose 'Plum Blossom by the current hour'. The system never picks a hexagram to suit the question.
hoi.kd.mau.gieo_lai: This question seems to have been cast recently. As the hexagram Meng (Youthful Folly) says, asking the same thing again empties the reading of value — sit with the hexagram you have first.
hoi.kd.gt.hao_dong.noi_dung: A line with the value 6 (old yin) or 9 (old yang) — it is turning into its opposite. Changing lines create the changed hexagram and are the focus of the reading.
hoi.kd.gt.que_bien.noi_dung: The hexagram you get after the changing lines flip between yin and yang. The primary hexagram is the present; the changed hexagram is where things are heading.
hoi.kd.gt.que_ho.noi_dung: Take lines 2–3–4 as the lower trigram and 3–4–5 as the upper trigram — it shows what is unfolding inside the matter.
hoi.kd.gt.luc_hao_mai_hoa.tieu_de: Six Lines (Na Jia) versus Plum Blossom
hoi.kd.gt.luc_hao_mai_hoa.noi_dung: Six Lines divination (Jing Fang, Zeng Shan Bu Yi) gives each line an earthly branch and a Six Relations role, then weighs the Use God line and its strength to judge success, failure and timing. Plum Blossom numerology (Shao Yong) builds the hexagram from the time or from things you notice, then weighs how the body and use trigrams feed or check each other, for a quick read of the matter at hand. The real difference is how the hexagram is raised: coins or yarrow stalks make six random lines (with old, changing lines); Plum Blossom takes numbers from the year, month, day and hour, or from something you encounter, to set the upper trigram, the lower trigram and one changing line — no casting needed.
hoi.kd.gt.dung_than.tieu_de: What is the Use God line?
hoi.kd.gt.dung_than.noi_dung: In Six Lines divination, the Use God is the line that stands for what you are asking about (money: Wealth; career standing: Officer; documents: Parent; children: Offspring; siblings and friends: Sibling). It must be fixed BEFORE you cast.
hoi.kd.gt.the_ung.noi_dung: The Self line (Shi) stands for the person asking; the Response line (Ying) stands for the other side or the matter. Where they sit depends on which palace the hexagram belongs to.
hoi.kd.gt.khong_gieo_lai.tieu_de: Why not cast again for the same question?
hoi.kd.gt.khong_gieo_lai.noi_dung: The Judgment of Meng says: the first asking is answered; asking again and again is disrespectful. Casting until you get a hexagram you like is choosing your own answer — the reading loses its value as a moment of reflection.
hoi.kd.gt.dong_xu_co_thi.noi_dung: Yarrow stalks give different odds of an old (changing) line from coins: old yin 1/16 and old yang 3/16 with yarrow, against 1/8 each with coins. The system uses cryptographic randomness for both.
hoi.kd.gt.boi_hay_triet.tieu_de: Is the I Ching for fortune-telling?
hoi.kd.gt.boi_hay_triet.noi_dung: The ancient Zhou Yi began as a divination manual of the Western Zhou; the Ten Wings read it again as philosophy. Here a hexagram is used as a signal for looking again at a decision, not as a prophecy.
hoi.kd.gt.thap_duc.noi_dung: Ten commentaries (Tuan upper and lower, Xiang upper and lower, Xici upper and lower, Wenyan, Shuogua, Xugua, Zagua), formed from the Warring States to the Han, which read the Zhou Yi as a book of ethics.
hoi.kd.gt.tuan_khong.noi_dung: In Six Lines divination: a line whose branch falls in the 'void' of the ten-day cycle of the casting day is void; a line clashed by the month branch is a month breaker — both are signs of weakness. (The system will work these out once solar terms are in place.)
hoi.kd.gt.hoi_que.tieu_de: How should I ask the I Ching?
hoi.kd.gt.hoi_que.noi_dung: One matter, one question — concrete, with a clear time frame; decide in advance what would show the reading was wrong; do not ask about the same matter many times.
hoi.kd.gt.sau_hao_dong.noi_dung: Following Zhu Xi (Introduction to the Study of the Changes): Qian and Kun read the 'use the nines' / 'use the sixes' statements; any other hexagram reads the Judgment of the changed hexagram.
hoi.kd.doan.que: {vai}: {ten} {han} (hexagram {so}) — {y} Advice from the meaning-and-principle reading: {kh} The shadow side to avoid: {mt}
hoi.kd.doan.quy_tac: How to read it (Zhu Xi's rule): {nd}
hoi.kd.doan.thoan: The Commentary on the Judgment explains: {x}
hoi.kd.doan.the_dung: Plum Blossom — the body trigram is {the} ({the_nh}), the use trigram is {dung} ({dung_nh}): {ten}. {y} {ly}
hoi.kd.doan.phuc: Six Lines — the Use God line ({dt}) does not show in the primary hexagram (it is hidden): what you are asking about has not come into view yet. {ghi}
hoi.kd.moc.ghi_chu: This hexagram is read for what you plan to do in {moc}. The I Ching looks at the shape of things at the moment you cast; it does not score each month or year separately — if you are weighing two dates, choose the one you can be better prepared for.
hoi.kd.nguy_hiem_nguoi: You are in danger right now — please do not cast a hexagram: call the police or your local emergency number, lock the door and get somewhere safe. Once you are safe, you can ask again.
hoi.kd.nha_nguy_hiem: This is a dangerous situation happening right now, not a question for a hexagram: get everyone out into fresh air, do not switch lights or appliances on or off, and call emergency services straight away. Once you are safe, you can ask again.
hoi.kd.mo.moc: The I Ching looks at the shape of things at the moment you cast; it does not score each month or year separately — if you are weighing two dates, choose the one you can be better prepared for
hoi.kd.mo.khong_quyet: The hexagram does not decide for you; it shows the shape of things right now so you can choose how to act.
hoi.kd.tq.dong: A changing line in this reading.
hoi.kd.tq.yen: A still line in this reading — read it through the hexagram's overall text.
hoi.kd.tq.ghi_chu: Line 1 is at the bottom. Highlighted lines are changing — the part of the hexagram in motion; the gold line is the main line.
